title: The Latest Crier for Oct 27, 2026
items:
Peer PE

Peer PE is back! Join SAAC as we host middle- and high-school students for a morning of movement and fun! Wear RED and plan to be active! Your role as volunteer is flexible; please come-and-go as your schedule allows. Logistics: November 3, 9:30-11 am, Location: Kuyper fieldhouse

3 vs. 3 Intramural Basketball Sign-Ups

3 vs. 3 Basketball Sign-Ups Are Open! Don't miss your chance to hit the hardwood. Register your team today! Sign up here: 3x3 Basketball Intramural Sign-Ups – Fill out form

Disc Golf Intramurals

Disc Golf Sign-Ups Are Open! Join us for three weeks of friendly competition and fun on the course. Register today! 
Sign up here: Disc Golf Intramural Sign-Ups – Fill out form

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 11/1/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu

Murder Mystery Party - free for all students!

JUST A FEW SPOTS LEFT! 
Murder Mystery Party - free for all students! SSS & CAB are having a Halloween Murder Mystery in the Graham Annex at 7:30 pm on Thursday, October 29. You can choose to have a part in this fun mystery or just try to solve the murder with your friends! Enjoy hot cider, popcorn, and pumpkin bars! 

Limit to 25 students - reserve your spot NOW! 

RSVP to diehlm@central.edu

Big Red Mascot Student Position

Big Red Mascot Student Position You could work a normal campus job... OR you could be Big Red!Central is looking for students to join the Big Red team as Big Red mascots and handlers for the 2026-2027 school year! 
Interested? Apply Here!

CAB Positions Open!

The best campus events don't happen by accident. They're planned by students like you. CAB leadership positions are now open! If you're creative, organized, and want to make a difference at Central, apply today. Applications close: 11/06/26 

Apply here: https://recruiting.paylocity.com/recruiting/jobs/Apply/4614356/Central-College/Student-CAB-Generalist

Professional Networking Event

Join us on Thursday, Nov. 5th at 6 pm in the Central Market side rooms for a night to learn about a career of your choice! Sign up by sending your name & the professional career choice to Matt at diehlm@central.edu. You will eat your meal with your professional and other college students. Open to all! Sponsored by SSS.

Fall Intramural Sign-Ups

Fall Intramural sign-ups are open! Make sure to get your teams together and sign up for those! Follow along on our Instagram (@CentralCollegeIM) for updates on when sign-ups open/close! Use our Linktree to take you to our hub for sign-ups: https://linktr.ee/centralcollegeim

Costumes, Karaoke, and Cash Bar!

Costumes, Karaoke, and Cash Bar! Join us for a Halloween party on Friday, October 30th from 9-11 pm in the BMW rooms (1st floor of Maytag). We'll have karaoke , a costume contest , snacks , and a cash bar for those 21 and older. Cash prizes will be awarded to the winners!

Flying Pans Steel Band presents Caribbean-Rock show "PAN LEGACY" Oct 31 & Nov 1

Take a "spooky-filled" Halloween musical journey with the Flying Pans Steel Band as they perform, Sat, Oct 31 at 7pm and Sun, Nov 1 at 3pm in Douwstra. Steel drums, special effects, lights and video featuring the songs MIDNIGHT FLYER and WITCHY WOMAN (Eagles), CRAZY (Willie Nelson), SOFRITO (Mongo Santamaria), SPIDERWEBS (No Doubt), CAN'T TAKE MY EYES OFF YOU (Frankie Valli), TOCCATA & FUGUE in Dm (J.S. Bach), FRANKENSTEIN (Edgar Winter Group), and CARRY ON WAYWARD SON (Kansas). Costume Contest during Oct 31 show! Get tickets now at https://central.universitytickets.com or at Douwstra day of shows: $10 Adults/Seniors/Students, FREE with Central I.D.

Entrepreneur Speaker Series 11/2 Alie Muller-Heit

Please join the BCOMM department in welcoming Ali Muller-Heit of Thistles Flower Market. 
Her speaking engagement will be 11/2 at 3pm in the BMW rooms. 

Alie Muller-Heit is the proud owner of Thistles Flower Market, a coernstone of Pella's downtown for over 40 years. With a passion for planning personalized moments, Alie loves creating meaningful designs for customers and brides alike.

Fellowship of Christian Athletes - Next Couple Weeks

The Well Volunteer Night: 
Tomorrow, 10/27 , FCA is doing a volunteer night at The Well from 7:30-8:30pm instead of our regular gathering. Space is limited to 30 students, so be sure to sign up soon to serve! Use the following link to sign up: 
10.27 FCA Volunteer Night at The Well Sign-Up Sheet.xlsx 

The Following Week: 

We will be meeting back in the BMW rooms next Tuesday, 11/3 , from 8-9pm for our regular FCA gathering. We hope to see you there! 

Have a great week! 

- FCA Leadership Team
